rationale: The Latin anchors *vastare* (to lay waste), *abolere* (to abolish/destroy utterly), and *subvertere* (to overturn/subvert) all point to a broad sense of causing destruction or undoing, matching destroy.v.01. The attestations from religious and heroic OE poetry (Elene, Salomon) suggest large-scale devastation rather than the irreparable damage of a specific object (destroy.v.02) or defeat in contest (demolish.v.03).
